name: @eidos.space/eidos-lite-desktop
description: Independent local-first desktop client for Eidos File Spaces
author: mayneyao

scripts.build: vite build && node scripts/verify-build-environment.mjs staging && node scripts/verify-electron-output.mjs
scripts.build:production: vite build --mode eidos-production && node scripts/verify-build-environment.mjs production && node scripts/verify-electron-output.mjs
scripts.package:dir: node scripts/verify-build-environment.mjs staging && node scripts/verify-electron-output.mjs && pnpm run native:electron && electron-builder --dir --publish never --config electron-builder.dev.json --config.npmRebuild=false
scripts.package:production:dir: pnpm run build:production && node scripts/verify-build-environment.mjs production && node scripts/verify-electron-output.mjs && pnpm run native:electron && electron-builder --dir --publish never --config electron-builder.json --config.npmRebuild=false
